releases.notes:
## Shared Life v2.0.0 (Minecraft 26.2)

### Compatibility & Verification Matrix
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader (Compatible with Fabric Loader `0.16.0` - `0.19.3+`)
- **Verified on**: Fabric Loader **`0.19.3`**
- **Minecraft Target**: **`26.2`**
- **Java Compatibility**: Java **`21`**, **`22`**, **`23`**, **`24`**, **`25`** (Tested on OpenJDK 25.0.4.1)
- **Side**: 100% Server-Side (Vanilla / Fabric clients can join without installing the mod)

---

### Highlights in v2.0.0
- **Multi-Loader Core Architecture**: Decoupled core synchronization engine for cross-platform compatibility.
- **Universal Shared Totem Pool**: A Totem of Undying held by any online teammate automatically saves the team from fatal damage.
- **Shared Absorption (Golden Hearts)**: Full synchronization of Golden Apple and potion absorption hearts across all players.
- **Damage Feedback**: Camera hurt tilt and pain sounds synchronized to all players when damage is taken.
- **Configurable Threshold & Single Culprit Death Notice**:
  - Customizable `minDamageNotificationThreshold` to avoid minor damage chat spam.
  - Announce only the primary player who caused the team wipe without repetitive death messages.

readmeSummary: A lightweight, server-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 where all online players share health, hunger, status effects, totems, and destiny.
